mapper.select: SELECT status,COUNT(*) order_count FROM sales_order GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payment WHERE status='SUCCESS'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_qty),0) available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(available_qty <= reorder_point),0) low_stock_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sku) sku_count FROM inventory

SELECT ch.channel, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.channel=ch.channel AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) order_count, (SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.channel=ch.channel AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) order_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM sales_order o WHERE o.channel=ch.channel AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) customer_count, (SELECT SUM(i.quantity) FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sales_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.channel=ch.channel AND o.ordered_at>=#{from} AND o.ordered_at<#{until}) units FROM (SELECT 'WEB' channel UNION ALL SELECT 'APP' UNION ALL SELECT 'MARKETPLACE' UNION ALL SELECT 'STORE') ch
